app.subtitle: A living collection of knowledge
nox.title: NoX Sync
nox.description: Import notes and images as private drafts. Publish each page when it is ready.
nox.urlHint: Use the backend's base URL, without /v1.
nox.keyHint: A key is saved. Leave this field empty to keep it.
nox.disconnectHint: The saved key will be removed. Imported pages and their history will remain.
nox.noVaults: No active vaults are available for this key.
nox.noNotes: No Markdown notes match this view.
nox.confirmReplace: Replace the selected local drafts with the imported versions. Existing history and public versions will be preserved.
nox.result: {{count}} notes processed. Public pages have not changed.
nox.cancelled: Preparation cancelled. No pages were changed.
nox.private: Notes and imported images stay private until Publish.
nox.selectionExpired: The prepared import is no longer available. Refresh the file list and prepare it again.
error.noxConnection: The NoX Sync server could not be reached. Check its URL and try again.
error.noxAuth: The API key is invalid or has been revoked. Update the connection key.
error.noxContract: The server response does not match the NoX Sync read API. Check the backend version.
error.noxChanged: A selected file changed, was renamed or was removed. Refresh the file list before importing again.
error.noxIntegrity: A downloaded file does not match its selected hash or size. No pages were imported.
error.noxExpired: This selection or prepared import has expired. Refresh the file list and try again.
error.noxLocalChanged: A local draft changed after review. Prepare the import again to review the latest version.
error.noxHome: Importing over home.md is not allowed. Rename this note in the source vault first.
error.noxDeleted: This source note was deleted locally. Its history has been preserved; it will not be recreated automatically.
error.noxReserved: Notes cannot be imported into the reserved _images directory.
error.noxLimit: A selected image exceeds the 100 MiB import limit.
nav.title: Explore the codex
nav.label: Pages
nav.empty: No pages have been published yet.
toc.title: On this page
link.ambiguous: Multiple notes match: {{name}}. Use a folder path.
image.folderReady: Image folder selected. Click the image icon again to choose its file.
image.selectFolder: Select the _images folder in the system picker. Then click the image icon again to choose a file.
image.saved: Image reference saved. Publish the page to make it public.
error.imageFolder: Select the _images folder used by this wiki.
error.imageOutside: Choose a file inside the selected _images folder or its subfolders.
error.imageSelection: The selected image does not match a file in this wiki's _images folder. Copy it there first, then choose it again.
error.imageSelectionAmbiguous: Identical files exist in multiple folders. Use a browser with directory selection support, or enter the exact path relative to _images in Markdown.
error.imagePicker: The image picker could not be opened. Try again and allow access to the image folder.
editor.title: Edit Markdown
editor.pathHint: Use folders and a .md extension, for example guides/getting-started.md.
editor.saved: Saved. Review the page, then publish when ready.
editor.conflict: This page changed in another window. Your draft is safe. Compare it with the latest version before saving.
editor.rebase: Keep my draft against this version
editor.rebaseHint: Review the latest version and copy any changes you want to keep into your draft before continuing.
editor.external: The workspace has changed. Your draft has not been replaced.
move.title: Move or rename page
move.hint: The public address changes when you publish this page. Old published addresses will redirect then. Relative links in this page retain their destinations.
delete.title: Delete this page?
delete.description: {{path}} will disappear from the public wiki. Its versions will remain available in the local history.
history.title: Page history
history.description: Follow how this page has changed over time.
history.deleted: This version records the deletion of the page.
history.noDifference: The Markdown is identical in these versions.
error.invalidPath: This path is invalid or contains a reserved name.
error.pathExists: A page or file already uses that path.
error.homeProtected: The home page cannot be moved or deleted.
error.homeMissing: Create home.md in the content directory before starting the local workspace.
error.notFound: This page is no longer available. Choose another page from the navigation.
error.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Check the fields and try again.
error.tooLarge: This page exceeds the configured size limit.
error.conflict: The page changed in another window. Review the latest version before saving.
error.externalChanges: The document directory was changed outside the workspace. Files were preserved. Restore a consistent backup of the content and state directories before restarting.
error.gitSave: The version could not be saved. Your draft has been preserved.
error.publicationPending: The version was committed, but updating the workspace was interrupted. Reload to check its status. Your saved version has been preserved.
error.publishedState: The published versions could not be recovered. Restore a consistent backup of the content and state directories.
error.publishedPath: Another page is still published at this path. Publish its new path or delete that page before publishing here.
error.publishPending: Publication was recorded but delivery was interrupted. Retry Publish or restart the admin to complete it.
error.notPublished: This collection is not available yet. Please try again later.
error.forbidden: This request is not allowed from the current origin.
error.revision: This historical version is not available.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Your unsaved text has been preserved.
error.publication: The published snapshot could not be loaded.
